assistant|haight_ashbury_restaurant_list: Recommended Zuni Cafe, The Pork Store Cafe, Nopalito, The Alembic, Magnolia Gastropub, The Pork Store BBQ, and Cafe Cole in Haight-Ashbury
Zoe's Cafe - breakfast and brunch, organic and locally sourced ingredients
Foreign Cinema - breakfast/brunch, screens classic films while dining
Pork Store Cafe - casual breakfast and lunch, famous pork sandwiches
The Pork Store - dinner menu with creative, farm-to-table dishes
Nopalito - organic Mexican cuisine, sustainable and locally sourced
The Alembic - gastropub, farm-to-table dishes, craft beer selection
Coffee to the People - coffee and pastries, cozy atmosphere, outdoor seating
The Haight Street Coffee Shop - local favorite, relaxed neighborhood vibe
Ritual Coffee Roasters - well-known roaster with expertly crafted coffee drinks
assistant|zuni_cafe_description: Zuni Cafe: SF institution since 1979, famous for brick oven roasted chicken and Mediterranean dishes
assistant|pork_store_cafe_description: The Pork Store Cafe: casual spot for breakfast/brunch, famous Pork Store Sandwich with eggs, bacon, cheddar on sourdough
assistant|nopalito_description: Nopalito: organic farm-to-table Mexican dishes like tacos, burritos, grilled meats
assistant|the_alembic_description: The Alembic: gastropub with creative farm-to-table American cuisine and craft cocktails
assistant|magnolia_gastropub_description: Magnolia Gastropub: craft beer and pub fare including burgers, sandwiches, salads
assistant|pork_store_bbq_description: The Pork Store BBQ: casual spot with in-house smoked ribs, brisket, sausages
assistant|cafe_cole_description: Cafe Cole: cozy family-owned cafe with coffee, sandwiches, salads, baked goods
assistant|pork_store_cafe_breakfast_hour: The Pork Store Cafe serves breakfast all day, every day
assistant|pork_store_cafe_weekday_hours: The Pork Store Cafe hours Monday-Friday: 8:00 AM - 3:00 PM
assistant|pork_store_cafe_weekend_hours: The Pork Store Cafe hours Saturday-Sunday: 8:00 AM - 4:00 PM
assistant|pork_store_cafe_menu: Menu items: Pork Store Sandwich, omelets, pancakes, waffles, breakfast burritos, coffee drinks, juices, teas
assistant|suit_shopping_suggestions: Suggested searching local tailors in Haight-Ashbury, checking Union Square/Downtown SF, vintage/thrift stores, and asking locals or hotel staff
assistant|camping_gear_list: Recommended gear: waterproof tent, sleeping bag and pad, backpack, portable stove and cooking gear, flashlight/lantern/headlamp
assistant|camping_tips: Tips: choose level campsite with shade, pack layers, plan meals, stay hydrated, pack first-aid kit, follow Leave No Trace
assistant|scenic_drives_bay_area: Recommended Pacific Coast Highway, 17-Mile Drive, Golden Gate to Muir Woods/Sausalito, Napa Valley, Skyline Boulevard, and Mount Tamalpais
assistant|pacific_coast_highway_route: Pacific Coast Highway: drive south from SF to Santa Cruz (~1.5 hours), stopping at Half Moon Bay, Pescadero State Beach, Santa Cruz Beach Boardwalk
assistant|golden_gate_muir_woods_route: Golden Gate Bridge to Muir Woods (~30 min) then Sausalito (~15 min) for redwoods and waterfront views
assistant|napa_valley_route: Napa Valley: about 1 hour east of SF, rolling hills, vineyards, towns like St. Helena and Calistoga
assistant|road_closure_tips: Tips: check road conditions before trip, plan alternative routes, use GPS/mapping apps, keep emergency kit, keep gas tank full, take breaks

assistant|sf_neighborhood_recommendation: Fisherman's Wharf - close to waterfront, Alcatraz, Pier 39; touristy with restaurants, shops, street performers
North Beach - Italian-American culture, delicious food, lively atmosphere, walkable to Fisherman's Wharf
The Mission District - vibrant street art, trendy bars, amazing Mexican food; popular with young professionals and artists
Pacific Heights - upscale, beautiful Victorian homes, stunning Bay views, laid-back atmosphere; pricier
Hayes Valley - boutique shopping, art galleries, hip restaurants; walkable to City Hall and Civic Center
The Castro - famous for LGBTQ+ community, colorful Victorian homes, lively nightlife
Russian Hill - upscale, stunning views of Bay Bridge, Alcatraz, city skyline; quieter, walkable to Fisherman's Wharf
assistant|tailor_recommendation: Bespoke by Curtis Eliot - Financial District, bespoke suits with modern twist, high-quality fabrics
Martin Greenfield - over 60 years of experience, bespoke and made-to-measure suits, dressed notable figures
Suitsupply - SoMa neighborhood, made-to-measure suits at affordable prices, wide range of fabrics
The Tailor's Keep - Mission District, bespoke and custom alterations, variety of fabrics
Al's Attire - Haight-Ashbury, bespoke custom suits, sustainable and eco-friendly practices, locally sourced materials
assistant|suit_rental_recommendation: The Black Tux - suit rental option in San Francisco
Menguin - suit rental option in San Francisco
assistant|suit_fittings_advice: Expect 2-3 fittings for a perfect fit; book appointments well in advance
assistant|airport_transport_bart: BART from SFO to Civic Center Station: 30-40 minutes, fare approximately $9.65
assistant|airport_transport_supershuttle: SuperShuttle shared-ride van: $17-20 per person, 30-40 minutes depending on traffic
assistant|airport_transport_taxi: Taxis from airport to city: around $40-50 depending on traffic
assistant|airport_transport_ridehail: Uber/Lyft from airport: around $30-40 depending on time of day and vehicle type
assistant|airport_transport_private: Private car services from airport: fares starting at around $60-70
assistant|haight_ashbury_attraction: Amoeba Music - legendary record store with new and used vinyl, CDs, DVDs
The Red Victorian Bed & Breakfast - beautiful Victorian architecture and gardens
Golden Gate Park - walking trails, gardens, de Young Museum, California Academy of Sciences
assistant|sf_gift_idea: Personalized cable car bell with couple's names or initials

Golden Gate Bridge print or painting from local artists
San Francisco-themed home decor: vintage-style map, cable car vase, Giants/49ers items
Experience gift: sunset sail on the Bay, Alcatraz tour, SF cooking class
Local artisanal food basket with sourdough bread, Ghirardelli chocolate, Cowgirl Creamery cheese
Customized SF-themed photo album via Shutterfly or Snapfish
San Francisco-made jewelry: cable car charm or Golden Gate Bridge-inspired necklace
assistant|sf_wine_shop: The Wine Thief - two locations, wines from Napa/Sonoma/California, custom gift basket service
K&L Wine Merchants - over 40 years in business, wines from around the world, gift department, pairing services
Bi-Rite Wine & Spirits - Mission District, curated wines, craft beers, artisanal spirits, gift basket service
Wine.com - online resource, wide selection, custom gift basket service
The SF Wine School - SoMa, wine paired with cheeses, charcuterie, chocolates; pairing classes offered
assistant|gift_basket_additions: Artisanal cheeses from Cowgirl Creamery or Mt. Tamalpais
Cured meats from Bi-Rite or Fatted Calf
Fresh fruit or nuts from the Ferry Building Marketplace
assistant|travel_booking_advice: Book Airbnb in advance, especially during peak season June to August
